residential-interiors.answer: DMS Studio designs residential interiors in Mohali and across the Tricity. The service connects space planning, furniture, storage, finishes and lighting around the household’s daily needs. Design and execution responsibilities are defined in the agreed scope.
sections: A layout before a look

A home begins with the people using it. Share your daily routines, existing furniture and the rooms that need to work harder. We use that brief to discuss furniture placement, movement between spaces and the storage required before selecting a visual direction.
From one room to a whole home

A focused room brief needs clear boundaries: what stays, what changes and which services are affected. A complete home needs coordination between rooms so materials, woodwork and lighting feel connected. Tell us whether you need design support, execution or both.
What to prepare

Bring a measured plan if available, current photographs, your must-keep pieces and a working budget. For an occupied property, mention how you plan to live during the work. Finish samples should be considered alongside the room’s actual light and maintenance needs.
deliverables: A defined room-by-room brief and scope
Space and furniture layouts appropriate to the agreed service
Concept, material and finish direction
Storage and lighting coordination within scope
Execution responsibilities and approvals agreed before work
faqs: Can you work with furniture I already own?
Yes. Share dimensions, photographs and the pieces you want to retain. Their scale, condition and position should be considered when developing the layout.
Is execution included in residential design?
Execution is not assumed to be included in every design brief. Ask for a written proposal identifying design deliverables, supply, installation and any work handled separately.
Can a small home feel more spacious?
Thoughtful circulation, appropriately sized furniture and purpose-built storage can improve how a small home works. Opera Home in the portfolio is a useful example of a compact residential brief.
residential-interiors.projectProof: Opera Home is a Kurali Road 1BHK. Its case study documents compact-home planning, storage decisions and remote coordination to compare with your own measured layout.

turnkey-interiors.answer: Turnkey interiors connect design and execution under an agreed project scope. DMS Studio offers this service for residential and commercial spaces in Mohali and the Tricity, beginning with the brief, site condition, selections and delivery responsibilities.
sections: One scope, clearly defined

The word turnkey is useful only when the inclusions are clear. Discuss drawings, material selection, procurement, site work, installation and styling as separate line items. Record what is supplied by the studio, by specialist contractors and by you.
Decisions in the right order

Layouts come before final joinery and electrical coordination. Major material and product selections should be approved before orders or installation depend on them. A shared record of decisions helps keep the work aligned when individual choices change.
A realistic programme and budget

The programme depends on the site, scale of work, access, approvals and procurement. Compare quotations against the same specification and inclusions. Keep a separate allowance for agreed changes or issues discovered on site; avoid choosing solely from an unexplained per-square-foot figure.
deliverables: Written inclusions, exclusions and responsibilities
A design direction and coordinated selections
A project-specific programme after scope review
An approval process for materials and changes
Handover items and outstanding work recorded as agreed
faqs: Does turnkey mean everything is automatically included?
No. Appliances, loose furniture, civil work, specialist systems and decorative accessories may vary by proposal. The written scope is the reference for what is included.
Can you guarantee a completion date before reviewing my property?
A meaningful programme requires the scope, site condition, selections and dependencies. Discuss a target date early, then confirm the project-specific schedule in the proposal.
How should changes be handled?
Ask for changes to be documented with their cost and timing implications before approval. This keeps revised work separate from the original agreed scope.
turnkey-interiors.projectProof: Babbar Residency documents a 3BHK scope combining kitchen planning, living-room woodwork, false ceiling and lighting. The project page shows the completed space and its documented limits.

commercial-interiors.answer: DMS Studio provides commercial interior design for offices, salons and lifestyle spaces in Mohali and the Tricity. The brief brings customer experience, staff movement, furniture, lighting and the business’s visual identity into one layout.
sections: Start with how the business operates

Map customer arrival, waiting, service and departure alongside staff circulation and storage. Share equipment sizes, working positions and day-to-day maintenance needs. This turns a visual brief into a layout that can support the business.
Translate the brand into a space

Colour, material, proportion and light can express a business’s identity without relying on decoration everywhere. Review the key customer touchpoints and decide where the strongest visual moments belong. Essentia Salon in New Chandigarh demonstrates a documented commercial commission.
Coordinate the fit-out

Landlord conditions, building access, signage, equipment loads and specialist services need to be identified early. Relevant statutory approvals and specialist safety requirements must be confirmed for the particular use. The interior proposal should state the work and coordination it covers.
deliverables: A functional brief based on visitors, team and operations
Space planning and furniture layouts
Material and lighting direction
Equipment and specialist-service coordination within scope
An execution plan tied to the agreed fit-out requirements
faqs: Do you design salon interiors?
Yes. Essentia Salon in New Chandigarh is a documented DMS Studio project. Its portfolio page includes original photographs, custom furniture and lighting context.
Can you plan a small office?
Share the team size, workstations, meeting needs, storage and visitor requirements. The suitability and scope can then be discussed around the actual space.
Are business approvals included?
Do not assume they are. Identify the required permissions and specialist responsibilities with the relevant parties, and record any coordination included in the studio’s proposal.
commercial-interiors.projectProof: Essentia Salon in New Chandigarh is a documented commercial example. Its project page shows the storefront and interior, with custom furniture and lighting in the listed scope.

modular-and-lighting.answer: DMS Studio offers modular kitchens, wardrobes, false ceilings and lighting design in Mohali and the Tricity. These elements are planned together with room layouts, appliance dimensions, services and everyday storage needs.
sections: A kitchen designed around use

Begin with preparation, washing, cooking and storage. Check appliance dimensions and how cabinet doors and drawers open. Plumbing, extraction and electrical points should be coordinated before the cabinet layout is finalised.
Storage with a specific purpose

A wardrobe is more useful when its internal layout matches what it holds. Discuss hanging, folded clothes, luggage and accessories separately. Compare finishes and hardware with a written specification, and review samples rather than relying only on photographs.
Ceilings and light belong to the same plan

False ceilings affect visual height and the position of lighting. Consider daylight, task light, glare and access for maintenance before adding decorative features. Final wiring and installation should be handled by appropriately qualified professionals.
deliverables: Kitchen or wardrobe requirements and measured layout
Appliance and service-point coordination within scope
Material, finish and hardware selections
Ceiling and lighting direction where included
Written supply and installation responsibilities
faqs: Should I choose appliances before the kitchen is finalised?
Confirm the models or accurate dimensions before approving cabinetry. Appliance clearances, electrical loads and ventilation requirements affect the final layout.
Which material is best for a modular kitchen?
There is no single answer for every brief. Discuss moisture exposure, use, finish, maintenance, budget and the documented product specification with the studio.
Can lighting be updated without a complete renovation?
That depends on the existing wiring, ceiling and fittings. Share photographs and the issues you want to solve; a site assessment can establish the suitable scope.
modular-and-lighting.projectProof: Babbar Residency’s project record includes a modular kitchen alongside living-room woodwork and cove lighting, showing how cabinetry can sit within a coordinated home scheme.
